claims.claim: Interest is not automatically taxed at 25%. Section 125C(b) sets a general 25% for an individual; Section 125C(c)(1) charges 15% where the interest is paid on an asset that is NOT index-linked, only partly linked, or unlinked to redemption; and Section 125C(d) overrides both with the full marginal rate under Section 121 where the interest is business income or recorded in the books, where interest and linkage expenses were claimed on the asset, where the recipient is a material shareholder in the payer, or where he is an employee, supplier or other special-relations party of the payer. Section 2(4) is a charging section and fixes no rate. בעברית: סעיף 2(4), סעיף 125ג(ב), סעיף 125ג(ג)(1) וסעיף 125ג(ד) לפקודת מס הכנסה, וסעיף 121.
claims.raw_snippet: שולמה הריבית על נכס שאינו צמוד למדד, או שהוא צמוד בחלקו לשיעור עליית המדד, כולו או חלקו, או שאינו צמוד למדד עד לפדיון או עד להחזר, תחויב הכנסתו של היחיד מריבית במס בשיעור של 15%

claims.claim: ITA professional circular 05/2025 on the 2% limb (s.121B(a1)): the 2% is charged only on the part of capital-source income that itself exceeds the 721,560 threshold. Example 2: salary 400,000 plus capital income 700,000 (total 1,100,000) gives 3% on (1,100,000 - 721,560) = 378,440, i.e. 11,353, and NO 2% because the capital income (700,000) is below the threshold. Example 3: total 1,500,000 of which 1,100,000 capital gives (1,500,000 - 721,560) x 3% = 23,353 plus (1,100,000 - 721,560) x 2% = 7,569, total 30,922. Capital-source income is income not produced from work or from a business, so business income bears only the 3%.

claims.claim: Surtax (s.121B(a)) thresholds by tax year from the Ordinance bracket table: 649,560 in 2019, 651,600 in 2020, 647,640 in 2021, 663,240 in 2022, 698,280 in 2023, 721,560 for 2024 through 2027; before 2025 only the 3% limb existed and it applied to total taxable income, capital gains included. The calculator carries 2019-2027 only.

Section 121(a)(1): individual taxable income is taxed at 31% on the first 301,200 shekels (2026-2027 amounts), 35% to 560,280 and 47% above; the reduced brackets of s.121(b)(1) (10%, 14%, 20%, 31%) apply only to income from personal exertion and to income of an individual aged 60 or over. So staking or airdrop income that is not personal exertion starts at 31% for an individual under 60. Illustrations: 20 x 0.31 = 6.20; 6.20 + 2.50 = 8.70; 4,000 x 0.31 = 1,240. In shekels: 6.20 NIS, 2.50 NIS, 8.70 NIS, 1,240 NIS.
